description: A complete, user-friendly web portal with login/registration, dashboard with sidebar navigation, and user management features. MUST include working HTML pages, forms, and navigation - NOT just API endpoints.

features.name: Welcome/Login Page
features.description: CRITICAL: Create an actual HTML page (login.html or index.php) with a login form. NOT a JSON API endpoint. Users must see a web page with username/password fields and a login button. Include link to registration page.
requirements: Full HTML page with DOCTYPE, proper CSS styling
Login form with username and password fields
Submit button that POSTs to backend API

features.name: Registration Page
features.description: CRITICAL: Create registration.html (or register.php) with HTML form for new user registration. NOT just an API endpoint.
requirements: Full HTML page with registration form
Fields: username, email, password, confirm password
Success message and redirect to login

features.name: Dashboard Page
features.description: CRITICAL: Create dashboard.html (or dashboard.php) - the main page after login with sidebar navigation and content area. This is an HTML PAGE that users see in their browser.
requirements: Full HTML page with header, sidebar, and main content area
Left sidebar with menu items (icons + text): Dashboard Home, List Users, Update Profile, Settings, Logout
Main content pane that shows different content based on menu selection
Navigation must use JavaScript to load content without full page refresh

features.name: List Users Feature
features.description: When user clicks 'List Users' in sidebar, display table of all users in main pane
requirements: Display in HTML table with columns: ID, Username, Email, Created Date

features.name: Update Profile Feature
features.description: When user clicks 'Update Profile', show profile update form in main pane
requirements: HTML form with current user data pre-filled
Fields: username, email, bio, avatar URL

features.name: Settings Feature
features.description: When user clicks 'Settings', show settings form in main pane

features.name: About Page
features.description: Static about page accessible from public navigation
requirements: Full HTML page describing the User Portal

features.name: Contact Page
features.description: Contact form page accessible from public navigation
requirements: Full HTML page with contact form

backend_api_endpoints.description: Register new user - validates input, hashes password, stores in database
Authenticate user - validates credentials, creates session
backend_api_endpoints.returns: JSON with success message and user data

backend_api_endpoints.description: Get list of all users (requires authentication)

columns.name: updated_at
columns.type: TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

styling_requirements.fonts: Modern sans-serif (Inter, Roboto, or system fonts)
styling_requirements.responsive: Mobile-first design, sidebar collapses to hamburger menu on mobile
styling_requirements.icons: Use Font Awesome or SVG icons for menu items

critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_HTML_PAGES: CRITICAL: Generate actual HTML pages that users can visit in a browser. Do NOT generate only API endpoints. Every feature must have a corresponding HTML page or section.
critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_FORMS: CRITICAL: All user input must be through HTML forms with proper input fields, labels, and buttons. Users must see forms they can fill out.
critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_NAVIGATION: CRITICAL: Include working navigation with proper href attributes or JavaScript navigation. Users must be able to click links and navigate between pages.
critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_HTACCESS: CRITICAL: Generate .htaccess file for URL rewriting so all routes work properly.
critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_SESSION_MANAGEMENT: Implement PHP sessions for login/authentication state
critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_PASSWORD_HASHING: Use password_hash() and password_verify() for security
critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_SQL_INJECTION_PROTECTION: Use prepared statements for all database queries
critical_requirements.MUST_HAVE_XSS_PROTECTION: Escape all user input with htmlspecialchars()
critical_requirements.MUST_BE_IMMEDIATELY_USABLE: After deployment, user should be able to open browser, visit the site, see login page, register, login, and use all features WITHOUT any manual configuration or code fixes
